country.name: Cameroon
country.officialLocalName: Republic of Cameroon / République du Cameroun
country.jurisdictionNotice: Basic, secondary, technical and vocational, and higher education are administered under distinct authorities. The Anglophone and Francophone subsystems are constitutionally and operationally distinct and must never be merged into a translated generic curriculum.
country.languagePolicy: English and French are official languages and the two education subsystems preserve distinct curricula, examinations, terminology and administration. National and community languages require language-, region-, orthography- and community-specific review.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Cameroon reviewer, current authoritative evidence and review by the competent ministry, territorial delegation, regulator or institution.

governanceModel.summary: MINEDUB governs nursery and primary education, MINESEC governs general, technical and teacher secondary education, MINEFOP has distinct vocational-training responsibilities, and MINESUP governs higher education. Regional and divisional delegations retain territorial responsibilities within their ministry.
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve ministry, subsystem, region, division, subdivision or council, official identifier, order, level, sector, current operating status and source year. An annual statistical school map is not a live authorization directory.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Institution authorization, authorization to open an exact program, habilitation or homologation, academic tutelage, national-diploma authority, professional recognition and CAMES-related recognition are distinct claims.

authorities.name: Ministry of Basic Education (MINEDUB)
authorities.role: nursery and primary education policy, curriculum, administration and statistics

authorities.name: MINEDUB regional and divisional delegations
authorities.role: territorial administration, inspection and school-record validation within delegated authority

authorities.name: Ministry of Secondary Education (MINESEC)
authorities.role: general, technical, vocational and teacher secondary education administration and statistics

authorities.name: MINESEC regional and divisional delegations
authorities.role: territorial secondary-school administration and record validation

authorities.name: Ministry of Employment and Vocational Training (MINEFOP)
authorities.role: vocational training and employment-related training within its mandate

authorities.name: Ministry of Higher Education (MINESUP)
authorities.role: higher-education institution and program authorization, national diplomas and academic tutelage

authorities.name: National commissions and inspectorates responsible for curricula and textbooks
authorities.role: approval and oversight of exact curricula, teaching materials and textbooks within their mandates

authorities.name: Ministry of Social Affairs and competent child-protection services
authorities.role: child protection and referral within assigned statutory responsibilities

curriculum.authority: Competent MINEDUB or MINESEC curriculum authority for the exact subsystem and level
curriculum.title: Cameroon official curricula by Anglophone and Francophone subsystem
curriculum.implementationRule: The 2018 Cameroon Primary School Curriculum and 2018 Curriculum de l’Enseignement Primaire Francophone Camerounais document two distinct subsystems with related competency domains but distinct learning methods, evaluation tools and materials. An older report describing those curricula is not proof of the controlling 2026 version.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: Curriculum, syllabus, implementing order, circular, approved textbook, examination syllabus, teacher guide and external resource are separate layers.

schoolDirectory.authority: MINEDUB or MINESEC and the responsible regional or divisional delegation
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: Official yearbooks enumerate schools by subsystem, order and geography, but a verified unified current public directory covering every public and private basic and secondary institution with authorization and operating status was not located. Statistical enumeration must not be presented as live authorization.
requiredRecordFields: observation year, source and review date

educationStatistics.authority: MINEDUB and MINESEC planning and statistics services within their respective scopes
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: The 2023–2024 yearbooks describe the 2023–2024 school year even when uploaded or republished later. Every value must preserve observation year separately from publication date, ministry, subsystem, level, sector, geography, definition and denominator.

vocationalQualifications.authority: MINESEC and MINEFOP within their distinct technical, vocational and training mandates
vocationalQualifications.authorityNotice: A provider identity, centre approval, trade or specialty approval, qualification framework entry, examination authority and certificate or diploma authority are separate claims. Verify the exact provider, location, program, level, modality, approval act, current status and award authority.

higherEducation.authorityNotice: A current institution listing does not authorize every program. Verify the exact opening authorization, habilitation or homologation, academic-tutelage convention, location, modality, national-diploma authority, validity and any professional or CAMES-related recognition separately. MINESUP states that no private higher-education institution in Cameroon is authorized to offer a PhD, including offshore doctoral provision.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Law No. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 relating to personal data protection
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenLaw: Constitution, ratified Convention on the Rights of the Child, Law No. 2016/007 of 12 July 2016 relating to the Penal Code as amended, and applicable education, social-affairs and safeguarding instruments
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: The 2024 data-protection law, its commencement, competent supervisory arrangements, implementing procedures, sensitive and biometric data, learner rights, transfers, retention and incident duties require current legal review. No single verified consolidated current Child Code was located; applicable child-protection rules, referral pathways and institutional responsibilities must be mapped before a real learner pilot.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: English and French education subsystems are distinct, not translations of one system. National and community languages, bilingual delivery and Cameroon Sign Language require exact region, community, language, orthography, curriculum approval, accessibility and reviewer evidence. Automatic English-French translation is not localization.

completionCriteria: A qualified Cameroon education reviewer is named.
MINEDUB, MINESEC, MINEFOP, MINESUP and territorial responsibilities are correctly separated.
A verified current unified school directory is documented or the gap remains visible.
Every statistic preserves observation year separately from publication date and scope.
Every curriculum record preserves Anglophone or Francophone subsystem, level, subject, language, order, version and effective year.
Every technical or vocational claim separates provider, program, approval and award authority.
Every higher-education claim separately verifies institution, program, tutelage, award, site, validity and recognition.
No private PhD offer is represented as authorized contrary to the current MINESUP warning.
Privacy implementation and the consolidated child-safeguarding framework are reviewed before a real learner pilot.
English, French, national and community language resources preserve their distinct educational contexts.
